cards.title: What the middleware decides
items: Only hosts outside the Skillifly set are looked up as custom domains.
An unknown host falls through unchanged and may 404.

cards.title: Left out
items: Localhost redirect and blog-host switching do not apply to this request.
The CSRF-origin middleware only matters for form posts.
